categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: general equipment manufacturing (pump industry) and environmental governance. The manufacturing segment focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of stainless steel centrifugal pumps and related equipment. The environmental governance segment includes hazardous waste disposal, environmental consulting, survey and design, and environmental project operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes independent R&D and technological innovation, with advanced manufacturing processes such as stamping and welding for stainless steel centrifugal pumps. It employs intelligent manufacturing, digital control systems, and energy-efficient designs including permanent magnet synchronous variable frequency pumps. The environmental segment uses core technologies like wet extraction, hazardous waste incineration, and resource recovery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span municipal water treatment, industrial wastewater, HVAC, fire protection, pharmaceuticals, electronics, metallurgy, energy, agriculture, and food and beverage industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant sales in China and growing exports to Southeast Asia, Russia, and other Belt and Road countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with manufacturing and service facilities concentrated in Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Hunan, and other provinces. It also has subsidiaries and sales operations in the United States, Spain, and Singapore, targeting global markets including Southeast Asia, Russia, and beyond.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing pumps and providing environmental services. It controls design, production, sales, and after-sales service, and also manages hazardous waste treatment and environmental consulting, integrating upstream resource recovery with downstream equipment supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the core pump manufacturing business, expanding environmental governance services, and enhancing technological innovation. R&D focuses on product upgrades, energy efficiency, digitalization, and intelligent manufacturing. The company invests heavily in developing new pump types, improving testing technologies, and advancing environmental treatment processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of pumps and related equipment, environmental service fees including hazardous waste disposal, consulting, design, and project operation income. The company also earns from resource recycling and government subsidies. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a domestic leader in stainless steel multi-stage centrifugal pumps, holding the largest production and sales volume in this segment in China. It competes with international pump manufacturers from the US, Europe, and Japan in high-end markets, while leveraging its brand, technology, and cost advantages to expand market share domestically and abroad.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 5.43 billion, a 3.22% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 200.58 million, up 73.63%. The manufacturing segment contributed the majority of revenue and profit, showing steady growth. The company maintains a total asset base of over RMB 8 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced stainless steel pumps with energy-efficient and intelligent features, supported by strong R&D and a comprehensive service network. Its environmental services offer integrated hazardous waste treatment and consulting solutions with regulatory compliance and sustainability focus. The brand is recognized for reliability, innovation, and customer trust, aiming to provide differentiated, customized solutions across diverse industries.
